faqs.question: Can you pre-install software before delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can set up the operating system, Microsoft 365, antivirus and your business applications so machines are ready to use on arrival.

faqs.question: Do you supply in bulk for new offices or teams?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle bulk orders and can standardise configurations across your organisation for easier management.

faqs.question: How do I choose between a laptop and a desktop?
faqs.answer: Laptops suit mobile and hybrid staff, while desktops offer more performance per rupee for fixed desks. We'll recommend the right mix after understanding your team.
